evidence: Alters CScriptWitness representation and block/transaction deserialization in src/primitives/transaction.h, src/script/, and src/validation.cpp.
rationale: Resolves a critical block deserialization DoS vulnerability reported by researchers where adversarial blocks could exhaust node memory. Benchmarks in the PR description demonstrate that 'worst-case valid block deserialization time drops from 279 ms to 19 ms, with persisted block memory usage dropping from 106.8 MiB to 3.8 MiB and peak memory dropping from 182 MiB to 7.8 MiB.'
